2511-4694-6258-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2511-4694-6258-7306.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

539-728-849-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-849-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Anax triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1537-3817-4247-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Zealous Conscripts, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Zealous Conscripts from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

2178-3362-6495-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
2178-3362-6495-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the Dragon with mana value 6 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Bladewing.
When Bladewing dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2178-3362-6495-6542.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

511-817-4050-5902-7824.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

2350-3375-4200-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

465-670-1619-6144.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
465-670-1619-6144.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Goliath Paladin.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, it triggers, returning Goliath Paladin from exile to the battlefield.
When Goliath Paladin enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Goliath Paladin.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control
with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

3259-7175-7759.easyPrerequisites: Royal Talon Fighter Jet is a creature.
3259-7175-7759.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7175-7759.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Royal Talon Fighter Jet as attackers.
Royal Talon Fighter Jet triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3755-6633-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3755-6633-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3755-6633-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-2112-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Hound of Griselbrand enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Hound of Griselbrand enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
413-2112-6972.notes: If Hound of Griselbrand starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

3490-4476-4659-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4476-4659-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

240-2292-4927-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

7-1020-2866-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures excluding Myr Retriever that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-1020-2866-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {R}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Hamza.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {R}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Hamza.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-560-2416-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Rise and Shine.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3443-3750.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard.
3443-3750.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

104-3490-4210-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4210-4659.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Pious Evangel or Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain life and target opponent to lose 1 life if Wayward Disciple triggered.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1286-2921-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

38-2173-5220-5708.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

222-527-6791-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6791-6798.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

914-3036-5295.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3036-5295.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

3688-5702-5954-6664.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
3688-5702-5954-6664.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
3688-5702-5954-6664.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

440-1339-2034-5070.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-2034-5070.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

478-983-2821-3664-3918.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five lands.
Trazyn does not have summoning sickness.
478-983-2821-3664-3918.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Temple of the False God by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Minamo, Lotus Field and Temple of the False God.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1322-3259-5359.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-5359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1077-3221-3283.description:
Cast Wrong Turn by paying {2}{U}, giving control of Notion Thief to an opponent.
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Consecrated Sphinx triggers, causing the opponent to draw two cards due to Notion Thief.
Consecrated Sphinx triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, causing the opponent to draw two cards due to Notion Thief.
Repeat from step 4 until the opponent loses the game due to drawing from an empty library.

567-2919-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
567-2919-3490-4659.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve all but one Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the last Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

1737-4636-4659-5146.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Thopter Assembly triggers.
Holding priority, activate Prototype Portal by paying {6} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart.
Gonti's Aether Heart enters the battlefield, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Resolve the Thopter Assembly trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand and creating five 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
The Thopters enter the battlefield, triggering Gonti's Aether Heart five times, causing you to get ten {E}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks five times by sacrificing the five Thopters, adding ten {C}.
Cast Thopter Assembly by paying {6}.
Thopter Assembly enter the battlefield, triggering Gonti's Aether Heart, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Activate Gonti's Aether Heart by paying eight {E} and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1170-2701-4125-4923.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Shipwreck Dowser.
Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, returning Cabal Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Shipwreck Dowser.
Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Cabal Ritual, adding at least {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

254-862-2034-5224.description:
Cast First Day of Class, allowing yourself to loot once due to learn and making it so whenever a creature enters the battlefield under your control this turn a +1/+1 counter will be put on it.
Cast Crimson Kobolds.
First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crimson Kobolds.
 Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, making it so the next time Crimson Kobolds dies this turn, it returns to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, adding {2}.
Together Forever triggers, returning Crimson Kobolds to your hand.
Repeat.
